text:
Zara P: quick notice — All-Hands this Friday 9:30am PT. agenda (20m total): 1) Exec snapshot + hiring priorities (5m) 2) Policy announcement: default hosted retention + PII handling (7m) 3) Dedicated launch ops & migration office-hours (5m) 4) Live Q&A + 2-min actionables. drop Qs here. :loudspeaker:
Ben H: will we publish a short customer-facing blurb we can reuse in support tickets?
Zara P: yes — we'll share a one-paragraph blurb and an FAQ. also slides + transcript after meeting.
Olga K: timeline for retention change? any staging vs prod differences?
Ravi S: ops reply: Hosted prod default moves to 100-day rolling logs; non-prod stays 14 days. Dedicated tenants keep current settings unless tenant admin migrates. migration is staged: pilot -> 5-day ramp -> full enforcement day 10.
Marta L: can we include a "what to do" slide for eng teams? two bullets they can forward.
Zara P: will do. example bullets: 1) audit ingestion clients for the new PII-scrub header 2) if you manage Dedicated, schedule migration during office-hours.
Ben H: any billing impacts?
Ravi S: no cost change for default 100-day. archives >100d are billable. we'll include sample pricing scenarios.
Olga K: accessibility: enable captions & transcript.
RecordingBot: captions enabled. recording + transcript will be posted to internal drive and linked here within ~1 hour after the meeting.
DevX-bot: slide deck will be shared 1 hour before the meeting in #all-hands.
Zara P: ops will run two migration office-hours next Tue/Thu 1-3pm PT for anyone needing hands-on help. we'll also post a short migration runbook and the console toggle demo.
Ben H: please include the SDK header example in the deck. tiny snippet: ```http
X-RW-PII-SCRUB: true
```
Ravi S: noted. we'll also show a hash-mode example and a short rollback playbook in case of issues.
Olga K: can we get a timestamped Q&A summary after the meeting? helpful for teams in EMEA.
Zara P: yes — we'll include a 1-paragraph TL;DR + timestamped Q&A and single-file takeaway you can forward to customers.
Marta L: last ask: can the follow-up package include a one-line "customer-facing email" copy for support to paste?
Zara P: yes — customer email template + internal checklist included. drop any other Qs here and we'll triage into the live Q&A. see you Friday! :rocket:
